_head: Phase 1's measurements, replayable. Boxes are design pt at capture scale 2.2417 (881x1910 for 393x852); run with --pt 2.2417. --against wants a directory of renders resized to 881x1910 with the masked corners composited onto the capture, which is what scratch/run.sh writes to scratch/cap/; every probe names its own file there. 'bright' on a sample means the ink is lighter than its ground; on a bbox it is the luminance above which a pixel is ink.
